The company’s future-proof product portfolio helps businesses provide frictionless customer onboarding and verification in 4-8 seconds while staying ahead of emerging threats and evolving regulatory requirements. We are looking for a talented and experienced QA Manager to lead our QA team and drive quality excellence across our products and platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping and executing the company's strategy, managing a team of QA professionals, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and reliable solutions.
